privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'bug' tag must be #d73a4a with $:/core/images/warning. The 'enhancement' tag must be #a2eeef with $:/core/images/star-filled. The 'documentation' tag must be #0075ca with $:/core/images/info-button. The 'Triage Dashboard' tiddler must have the tag '$:/tags/SideBar' and a field 'caption' set to 'Triage'. The dashboard content must use filters to list tiddlers: [tag[bug]tag[critical]] for Critical Bugs, [tag[enhancement]] for Enhancements, and [tag[documentation]] for Documentation.
